NFC Card Guide

How to program an NFC card with the NFC Tools app on an iPhone.

Showing instructions for .

What you need

  • An iPhone
  • A blank white NFC card
  • Your iPhone, within reach. The card is written with the phone, not the computer.
  • The NFC Tools app (free). Get it in the App Store

How it works

  1. Choose what the card should do. There are many options. Then enter the details in the app.
  2. Tap Write, then hold the card against the back of the phone, near the cameras.
  3. When the screen shows a blue checkmark, the card is ready.

Guides

    Tip: switch between this page and the NFC Tools app as you go. Keep this page open so you do not lose your place.
